sources.title: Market situation and outlook
sources.date_kind: period end; publication date not supplied on page

observations.overview: SSAB describes a strong North American plate market in Q3 2026, alongside rising prices.
observations.domestic: SSAB assesses North American distributor inventories as somewhat low for the reported quarter. This is an inventory assessment, not a published mill allocation or delivery schedule.
observations.pricing: SSAB reports that North American plate prices increased during Q3 2026. This describes a quarterly trend, not a current spot quote or a price for a particular grade or size.
observations.demand: SSAB’s Q3 2026 commentary indicates firm North American plate demand. It does not provide a current breakdown of plate orders by consuming industry.

observations.imports: AISI’s October 27 release reports total steel imports down 9.6% and finished steel imports down 13.8% year to date versus 2025, using preliminary Census data through September 2026. These totals cover all steel products and all origins, not plate alone.
